title: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering

entities.name: Tev Loneglade
entities.description: A powerful planeswalker and Tymolin's brother who, after her death, becomes the villain Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Tymolin Loneglade
entities.description: Human sister of Tev, hunted by the Farrelites and killed by Oliver Farrel.

entities.name: Kaylen
entities.description: A dwarf killed by an orc while defending a fortress in the Crimson Peaks.

entities.name: Oliver Farrel
entities.description: An ex-Icatian priest who leads the Farrelite blood cult and claims Tymolin is the dark god Tourach.

entities.name: Sianna
entities.description: Farrel's concubine and champion, tasked with slaying Tymolin.

entities.name: Loren
entities.description: An elven Master Scout and Thallid sympathizer killed by Morgan.

entities.name: Morgan
entities.description: A Thenolite Druid who has a family feud with Loren and kills him.

entities.name: Vaylesh
entities.description: Leader of the Order of the Ebon Hand who captures Tymolin.

entities.name: Farrelites
entities.description: Blood cult led by Oliver Farrel in Montford.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Faction led by Vaylesh that is later torn apart by a Thrull Rebellion.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Fungal creatures debated by the elven factions; they later help overrun Sarpadia.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Continent whose empires fall in this story.

entities.name: Havenwood
entities.description: Elven forest in Sarpadia where Tev lives and Loren is killed.

entities.name: Montford
entities.description: Town where Farrel stirs up a frenzy; target of the Orc-Goblin army.

entities.name: Tourach
entities.description: A dark god whom Farrel claims Tymolin to be.

events.summary: Kaylen is killed by an orc in a dwarven fortress while he and Tymolin hold back invading Orcs and Goblins; Tymolin slays the orc and then heads to Havenwood to find Tev.
events.quote: Sneaking behind Kaylen an orc runs him through from behind before Tymolin can warn him.

events.summary: Oliver Farrel whips Montford into a frenzy against the Ebon Hand and appoints Sianna as his champion to slay Tymolin.
events.quote: Farrel then appoints Sianna to be his champion bestowing his mantle upon her.

events.summary: The Farrelites ambush Tev and Tymolin; Tev summons a Wall of Bone, disenchants Farrel's mantle and escapes with a Darkness spell, but the siblings are separated.
events.quote: Not recognizing Tev to be a powerful planeswalker the blood cult attacks the pair ignoring him.

events.summary: Morgan traps Loren with several Thallids to ensure his mission fails.
events.quote: Morgan having a long-standing family feud with Loren relishes this opportunity and traps Loren with several Thallids creatures.

events.summary: Tev destroys the Thallids with a Fireball but leaves, and Morgan kills Loren with a poisoned arrow.
events.quote: Tev moves on as Morgan strikes Loren down with a poisoned arrow killing him.

events.summary: Vaylesh captures Tymolin and lures the Farrelites to the Ebon Hand camp; Farrel stabs Tymolin to death when she refuses him.
events.quote: Refusing his request, Tymolin is stabbed to death by Farrel while still tied up.

events.summary: Sensing her death, Tev transforms into a dragon-like Tevesh Szat and incinerates Vaylesh, Oliver and Sianna and their forces.
events.quote: Tev now Tevesh Szat soared in incinerating the thrull and all present including Vaylesh, Oliver, and Sianna.

events.summary: Tevesh Szat vows to destroy the Sarpadian empires from within and unleashes the Orc-Goblin army on Montford through a Planar Gate.
events.quote: he vows to destroy the empires from within.

events.summary: Sarpadia is plunged into chaos; the Ebon Hand is torn apart by a Thrull Rebellion and only thrulls and thallids remain.
events.quote: The Ebon Hand would be torn apart inside out by a Thrull Rebellion.
